en.title: NDIS Amendment Bill 2026 Passes Australian Parliament, Boosting Disability Support
en.summary: The Australian Parliament passed the NDIS Amendment Bill 2026, aiming to make the National Disability Insurance Scheme stronger, fairer and more sustainable. In other news, a European accessible tech accelerator introduced a mandatory co-creation standard with disabled users, while Miami University launched the GrackleScan accessibility tool. Darwin joined the Hidden Disabilities Sunflower program, and the Clallam County Fair opened with a new accessibility focus.

highlights.title: European Accessible Tech Accelerator Sets New Standard: Mandatory Co-creation with Disabled Users Improves Product Usability
Darwin Strengthens Inclusion with Hidden Disabilities Sunflower Program
New accessibility tool: GrackleScan - Miami University
Clallam County Fair Opens With New Focus on Accessibility

zh-TW.title: 澳洲 通過 NDIS 修正案 2026 加強 殘障 支援 與 永續 發展
zh-TW.summary: 澳洲議會通過了NDIS修正案2026，旨在使國家殘障保險計畫更強大、公平且可持續。同時，歐洲無礙科技加速器推出強制殘障共創的新標準，邁阿密大學則發佈GrackleScan無障礙工具。達爾文加入隱形殘障向日葵計畫，克拉拉姆縣博覽會亦以新焦點開放，關注無障礙設施。

highlights.title: 歐洲無礙科技加速器立新標準：強制殘障共創提升產品實用性
達爾文加入隱形殘障向日葵計畫，強化包容性
迈阿密大学推出新无障碍工具 GrackleScan
